correctness.rationale: In characteristic two Δ=xz+yt satisfies σ(Δ)=Δ and σ²=id; σ is nonidentity. U=x²+tΔx and V=y²+zΔy are invariant and z²U+t²V=(1+zt)Δ². F=(1+zt)D²+z²U+t²V is irreducible as primitive linear in U,V over k[z,t,D]; its hypersurface B has dimension four. The polynomial ring R is integral over the generated invariants S because x,y obey monic quadratics, hence S dim4 and the surjection B→S is injective. In K=Frac(R), y=(D+zx)/t and x has quadratic equation over L=Frac(B), so [K:L]=2 (nontrivial σ); therefore K^σ=L. F derivatives give common vanishing z=t=D=0, codim2, whence B satisfies R1, and hypersurface CM gives S2; it is normal. Integral invariant elements in L consequently equal B. The Jacobian ideal generated by (tD²,zD²,z²,t²) contains D² via D²=F+z²U+t²V+z*tD², so J=(D²,z²,t²) with B/J≅k[U,V,z,t,D]/(z²,t²,D²), rank8 over k[U,V]. The fixed reduced scheme has irreducible singular determinant quadric Δ=0; linear involutions have smooth linear fixed reduced loci, excluding polynomial conjugation. Independent characteristic-two symbolic checks confirmed all generator/action/Jacobian identities, direct GF2 counts 10 fixed/3 two-cycles, GF4 counts 76 fixed/90 two-cycles. Finite checks do not replace the field extension and normality proofs.

final_claim: Over algebraically closed characteristic-two k, σ:(x,y,z,t)↦(x+t(xz+yt),y+z(xz+yt),z,t) is a nonlinearizable polynomial involution; its whole invariant ring is k[z,t,D,U,V]/((1+zt)D²+z²U+t²V), with U=x²+tDx,V=y²+zDy, normal integral fourfold quotient, reduced singular plane z=t=D=0 and uniform length-eight Jacobian thickening (z²,t²,D²).
